# Nominet DNS
> Nominet DNS provides managed authoritative DNS, secondary DNS, and DNS traffic management services for UK organisations.

This site covers Nominet’s DNS platform, including product information, technical capabilities, operational guidance, and customer support resources for resilient DNS hosting and management.

## Core Product Pages
- [Nominet DNS](https://nominetdns.uk/): Overview of Nominet’s managed DNS services and platform capabilities.
- [Authoritative DNS](https://nominetdns.uk/authoritative-dns/): Managed authoritative DNS hosting for resilient, high-availability domain name service.
- [Secondary DNS](https://nominetdns.uk/secondary-dns/): Secondary DNS service for redundancy and improved DNS resilience.
- [Traffic Management](https://nominetdns.uk/traffic-management/): DNS-based traffic steering and failover for service availability and performance.
- [DDoS Protection](https://nominetdns.uk/ddos-protection/): DNS infrastructure protection features designed to mitigate denial-of-service attacks.

## Solutions
- [Public Sector](https://nominetdns.uk/public-sector/): DNS solutions tailored for government and public sector organisations.
- [Enterprise](https://nominetdns.uk/enterprise/): Managed DNS services for large organisations with critical online services.
- [Registrars](https://nominetdns.uk/registrars/): DNS capabilities and service options relevant to domain registrars.
- [Managed Service Providers](https://nominetdns.uk/managed-service-providers/): DNS platform support for MSPs delivering services to customers.
- [Critical National Infrastructure](https://nominetdns.uk/critical-national-infrastructure/): Resilient DNS services for essential and high-assurance environments.

## Features and Capabilities
- [Anycast Network](https://nominetdns.uk/anycast-network/): Global anycast DNS network designed for resilience, reachability, and low latency.
- [DNSSEC](https://nominetdns.uk/dnssec/): Support for DNSSEC to improve DNS integrity and trust.
- [IPv6](https://nominetdns.uk/ipv6/): IPv6 support across DNS services and network infrastructure.
- [Monitoring and Reporting](https://nominetdns.uk/monitoring-reporting/): Visibility and reporting features for DNS performance and service health.
- [Service Level Agreement](https://nominetdns.uk/service-level-agreement/): Availability commitments and service assurance information.

- [Business Continuity](https://nominetdns.uk/business-continuity/): Continuity and resilience planning for DNS service operations.
